item.title: Green Stocks Feb 25- IT has AI, Green energy has Trump Tariffs
item.description: In a market that has been swooning with every doomsday prediction linked to the impact of AI, especially on Indian IT firms, green energy stocks have their own nemesis. Donald Trump and his tariff actions. The latest move to slap a 126% tariff on Indian solar imports to the US was particularly harsh on solar exporters. item.title: Wind Energy Producer Not Entitled For Payment For Power Supply Post PPA Period: RERC
item.description: The Rajasthan Electricity Regulatory Commission (RERC), in its latest order, has rejected a petition filed by Intech Systems Chennai Pvt. Ltd, a wind energy generator. The green energy firm had earlier sought payment for the electricity supplied from its wind project after the expiry of a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with state distribution utilities. item.title: Kolkata Metro Launches Battery Energy Storage System on Blue Line
item.description: Metro Railway Kolkata has launched a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) on the underground portion of its Blue Line. The move is aimed at improving energy efficiency and ensuring commuter safety during unexpected power outages. Enhancing Underground Operations The underground segment of the Blue Line extends 17 km, connecting Dumdum and Mahanayak Uttam Kumar (Tollygunge). item.title: APTEL Dismisses Plea Challenging KERC Move to Bar Rooftop Solar Project Timeline Extensions
item.description: The Appellate Tribunal for Electricity (APTEL) has dismissed a petition challenging a directive issued by the Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission (KERC) that barred further time extensions for rooftop solar developers. The case concerned a letter issued by KERC on September 27, 2016, directing utilities not to grant additional extensions to developers of rooftop solar projects beyond the timelines prescribed under earlier tariff orders. The collaboration aims to expand commercial & industrial (C&I) storage applications in the region. item.description: ACME Solar Holdings Limited (ASHL) has commissioned the first phase of its large-scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project in Rajasthan. item.title: Websol Energy Bags 85.5 MW Solar Module Orders Worth ₹172 Cr from Three Companies
item.description: Kolkata-based Websol Energy System Limited has secured three solar module purchase orders, for 85.5 MW from three clients. In a press release, Websol Energy said it secured orders valued at Rs. 172 crores that are currently in production and are scheduled for delivery by May’26. It won these orders from clients such as Bekem Infra Projects, Sri Avantika Contractors, and Kosol Energie. item.title: KP Energy Secures 40.8 MW Wind-Solar Hybrid Project from Enerparc in Gujarat
item.description: Gujarat-based KP Energy Limited has received a Letter of Award (LoA) from Enerparc Energy Private Limited to develop a 40.8 MW wind-solar hybrid power project. As stated in a regulatory filing, KP Energy secured approximately 20.2 MW of wind capacity and 20.6 MWp of solar capacity in Gujarat.
